semantics.how: Pipes the paths NUL-separated into git check-ignore with a fixed argv, no shell and a C locale; exit 1, 'not a git repository' or a missing git binary yield an empty set, any other failure throws
semantics.what: Returns the subset of relative paths git ignores under a root
semantics.when: Called by listFilesContained and docs discovery
semantics.why: Ignored files exist locally but not in a clone, so analyzing them would make the committed store disagree with CI; failing loudly keeps a git error from silently re-admitting them
